{{Top|leg}}
A '''comm unit scrambler''', '''comlink scrambler''' or '''comm scrambler''' was a type of encryption technology that was smaller and less sophisticated than an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]]. Comm scramblers were built into a variety of technology, such as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. [[Coruscant Guard armor]] was equipped with a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] comlink scrambler so that [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] units could stay in touch without outside interference.<ref name="sof">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

A force of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and [[Sessehshellah]] stole a scrambler while infiltrating a [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]]. It allowed them to access the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] transmissions networks.<ref name="Bright Water">{{WEGCite|story=Rings of Bright Water|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
